target: Gazebo Harmonic / SDFormat 1.9 / ROS 2 Humble or Jazzy

noise_status: All noise values below are synthetic simulation tuning defaults, not measured hardware specifications.

sensors.name: porter_hflow
sensors.origin_status: Measured sensing-surface offset from the mesh origin.
sensors.hardware_assumption: Holybro H-Flow; confirm exact installed hardware.
verified_parameters: Flow effective FoV up to 42 degrees
ToF FoV 12.4 x 6.2 degrees / 32 pixels / typical maximum 30 m
provisional_parameters: Debug image resolution/rate (not a real H-Flow video output)
ToF/IMU output rates
8x4 ray grid and median reduction approximate the Broadcom return processing
ToF is temporarily co-located with the measured flow origin; measure its separate optical centre
IMU datum temporarily equals the mesh origin
42-degree effective view modelled as square pinhole HFoV
Noise/latency and IR illumination response are not calibrated

sensors.name: porter_rangefinder_200m
sensors.origin_status: Measured sensing-surface offset from the mesh origin.
verified_parameters: Generic single ray, nominal maximum 200 m
provisional_parameters: Minimum range, rate and noise are adjustable generic defaults
Single ideal beam; divergence and reflectivity response not modelled
No vendor-specific serial or CAN protocol emulation

sensors.name: porter_n6_camera
sensors.origin_status: Measured sensing-surface offset from the mesh origin; optical principal plane uncalibrated.
sensors.hardware_assumption: OpenMV N6 with a provisional PAG7936/2.8 mm lens reference profile; installed module unconfirmed.
sensors.source_discrepancy: Product YAML Rev 1 describes a default 5 MP HDR / 30 fps camera and an alternative 1 MP global-shutter module. Current product page describes PAG7936 1 MP as supplied. N6 supports interchangeable modules, so the active profile must be checked against the installed camera.
verified_parameters: PAG7936 reference module: 1280x800 colour global shutter
PAG7936 sensor maximum 120 fps at 1280x800; simulation defaults to 30 fps
Product YAML describes a 5 MP HDR module but does not specify its resolution/FoV or intrinsics
provisional_parameters: Installed module: 5 MP HDR versus PAG7936 1 MP global shutter; lens/intrinsics
PAG7936 reference profile is active until the installed module is confirmed
30 fps operating rate
Pinhole approximation: lens distortion is not calibrated or reproduced
Noise and exposure response
NPU, onboard algorithms, ISP, codecs and N6 IMU are not emulated

sensors.name: porter_mv_ca050_camera
sensors.origin_status: Measured sensing-surface offset from the mesh origin; optical principal plane uncalibrated.
sensors.hardware_assumption: Hikrobot MV-CA050-10GM/GC family. GC colour chosen provisionally; GM would use mono8.
verified_parameters: GM mono / GC colour are different variants

provisional_parameters: Exact GM versus GC variant
Lens focal length/FoV: 60-degree HFoV is a PLACEHOLDER
1224x1024 / 20 fps is a selected reduced simulation mode, not measured device configuration
Noise, distortion and exposure response
No GigE Vision or hardware-trigger emulation
